# Increased timeouts due to surge in anonymous users

## What Changed

Nov 9, 09:09 UTC Resolved - On November 9, 2026, GitHub.com experienced intermittent timeouts between approximately 05:10 and 08:15 UTC. Across that full window, 6.5% of recorded requests to github.com timed out, with a five-minute peak of 13.9% between 07:40 and 07:45 UTC. Release downloads were more affected: 38.5% of recorded requests timed out, peaking at 76% during that same five-minute interval. The two main error waves lasted about two hours and ten minutes in total, with recovery between them. The errors affected repository browsing and disrupted some CI workflows and Copilot code review jobs. Contrary to our earlier updates, follow-up analysis confirmed at least 6,236 authenticated requests that timed out, affecting activity feeds, access to uploaded attachments and repository archive downloads. Errors occurred during elevated traffic to our web infrastructure that handles unauthenticated requests. Impact was mitigated when traffic causing pressure on this system was alleviated. Our follow-up work focuses on improving capacity monitoring, traffic prioritization improvements, and automated protection against traffic spikes. Nov 9, 09:09 UTC Update - We are resolving this...
